id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for this component.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart), which is necessary if you have multiple UARTs defined in your configuration.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

dynamic_background_correction_status.docs:
True while the sensor is performing dynamic background correction. All options from [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor#config-binary_sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

has_moving_target.docs:
True if a moving target is detected. All options from [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor#config-binary_sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

has_still_target.docs:
True if a still target is detected. All options from [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor#config-binary_sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

has_target.docs:
If true target detect either still or in movement. All options from [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor#config-binary_sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

ld2412_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for the component. Required when using multiple components.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

factory_reset.docs:
This command is used to restore all configuration values to their original values. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

ld2412_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for the component. Required when using multiple components.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

query_params.docs:
Refresh all sensors values of the device. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

restart.docs:
Restart the device. All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

start_dynamic_background_correction.docs:
Start the Dynamic Background Correction All options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

ld2412_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for the component. Required when using multiple components.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

light_threshold.docs:
**int**: Threshold for the light to activate the OUT pin of the sensor. All options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

max_distance_gate.docs:
**int**: Maximum distance gate for still detection. Value between `2` and `13` inclusive. Defaults to `13`. All options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

min_distance_gate.docs:
**int**: Maximum distance gate for movement detection. Value between `1` and `12` inclusive. Defaults to `1`. All options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

timeout.docs:
**int**: Time in seconds for which the presence state will remain after presence is no longer detected. Defaults to `5s`. All options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

baud_rate.docs:
Allows changing the baud rate of the LD2412's serial port. Defaults to `115200`. Once changed, sensors will stop working until the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) is updated with the new baud rate in your device's configuration. All options from [Select](https://esphome.io/components/select#config-select).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

distance_resolution.docs:
Control the gates distance resolution. Can be `0.75m`, `0.5m` or `0.2m`. Defaults to `0.75m`. All options from [Select](https://esphome.io/components/select#config-select).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

ld2412_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for the component. Required when using multiple components.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

light_function.docs:
Allows selection of how the LD2412's OUT pin will react to the light level. Can be `off`, `below` or `above`. Note that this works in conjunction with presence detection. See the reference manual for details.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

out_pin_level.docs:
Allows selection of the LD2412's OUT pin behavior when the sensor detects presence. Can be `low` or `high`. Defaults to `low`. All options from [Select](https://esphome.io/components/select#config-select).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

detection_distance.docs:
**int**: Distance in cm of target. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

ld2412_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for the component. Required when using multiple components.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

light.docs:
**int**: When in [engineering mode](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#ld2412-engineering-mode), indicates the light sensitivity, otherwise indicates `unknown`. Value between `0` and `255` inclusive. Note that this is an arbitrary unit and does not correspond to any particular unit of measurement for intensity. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

moving_distance.docs:
**int**: Distance in cm of detected moving target. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

moving_energy.docs:
**int**: Energy for moving target. Value between `0` and `100` inclusive. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

still_distance.docs:
**int**: Distance in cm of detected still target. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

still_energy.docs:
**int**: Energy for still target. Value between `0` and `100` inclusive. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

bluetooth.docs:
Turn on/off the bluetooth adapter. Defaults to `true`. All options from [Switch](https://esphome.io/components/switch#config-switch).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

ld2412_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for the component. Required when using multiple components.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for the component. Required when using multiple components.

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

mac_address.docs:
The bluetooth mac address. Will be set to `unknown` when bluetooth is off. All options from [Text Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/text_sensor#config-text_sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*

version.docs:
The firmware version. All options from [Text Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/text_sensor#config-text_sensor).

*See also: [LD2412 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2412#configuration-variables)*
